subject: Post-incident readout: inference cluster surge — RCA delivery & closure cadence
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@fastretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident summary & RCA draft — Aug 26 surge on inference cluster

Hi Sandeep —

Thanks again for the emergency bridge yesterday. I know the latency and error spike was impactful and I want to make sure we close this cleanly. Attached is an initial RCA draft and a log bundle (inference-metrics-logs.zip) that the engineering team used to validate root cause hypotheses. Key summary:

- What happened: a sudden surge in synthetic traffic from a misconfigured batching client caused the serving runtime to misroute KV-cache states under a specific model shard mapping, which amplified tail latency and produced elevated 5xx rates for ~45 minutes on Aug 26 17:35–18:20 UTC.
- Impact: increased p95 latency from 180ms -> 750ms for affected routes; 5xx error rate peaked at ~7% for the window; throughput backpressure led to queueing and client retries.
- Immediate mitigations: we throttled cross-tenant batch size, applied a hotfix to shard routing, and added a temporary circuit-breaker.

Attached: 20280828-rca-draft.pdf and inference-metrics-logs.zip.

Next steps I propose (short-term, with owners):
1) Finalize RCA and deliver to your execs (owner: me) — target 48 hours.
2) Permanent fix to routing and improved validation in deployment (owner: Karthik) — deploy in next release with QA signoff.
3) Backfill missing telemetry/alert for this shard-balance condition (owner: Kim) — SLO: 2 weeks.
4) Run a coordinated load-test with your integration team to validate (owner: FastRetail, contact: Sandeep) — schedule next week.

Can you confirm a time for an executive readout call? We can do tomorrow afternoon or Friday morning. I’ll loop in Markus and Grace for post-release verification and customer success follow-through.

Apologies again for the disruption — we own this and will make sure you have a clear closure path and evidence of fixes.

- Lukas Meyer
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20280828-rca-draft.pdf (pdf), inference-metrics-logs.zip (zip)
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@fastretail.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Incident summary & RCA draft — Aug 26 surge on inference cluster

Lukas —

Thanks for the quick note and the draft. The impact was material for peak traffic — some orders timed out and downstream reconciliation had to be retried. We need the RCA and a firm remediation timeline for our leadership; can you commit to a Friday delivery for the finalized RCA?

Also need an exec-level readout (COO + VP Eng) — Friday 11:00 PT would work. Please include expected customer credits and whether this is a single-tenant configuration issue or something that could recur across other accounts.

Sandeep
VP Product, FastRetail

Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final RCA & corrective-action slate + exec readout invite (Fri 11:00 PT)

Sandeep —

Attached is the finalized RCA (20280830-rca-final.pdf) and a corrective-actions timeline (corrective-actions-timeline.csv). Summary (TL;DR):

Root cause: during a patch to routing logic earlier in the week we introduced a condition where the shard-to-GPU mapping table could be updated out-of-order for some in-flight batch states; combined with an unusually large batch emission from a FastRetail integration test, this produced inconsistent KV cache lookups and high tail latencies.

Corrective actions (owners & dates):
- Karthik: atomicize shard-mapping update and add version checks — target deploy 2028-09-02 (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Kim: new alert for shard-rebalance anomalies + dashboarding — ETA 2028-09-06 (owner: kimberly_park).
- Markus: add library-level validation on SDK batching config + release patch to SDK — ETA 2028-09-09 (owner: markus_klein).
- Grace (CS): run validation with FastRetail integration and confirm no regressions post-deploy — ETA 2028-09-11 (owner: grace_oconnor).
- Lukas: executive closure memo and credit proposal draft (to legal/finance) — ETA 2028-09-04 (owner: lukas_meyer).

We have also opened SRV-2389 (link below) to track the engineering work.

Executive readout: Fri, Aug 31 11:00 PT — calendar invite sent to your COO and VP Eng; I’ll present the RCA and proposed credits; Kim will show the new alert design and Markus will confirm the SDK fix path.

Please see attachments and the Jira link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRV-2389. I’ll follow up after the readout with the official closure packet.

Thanks —
Lukas

Attachments: 20280830-rca-final.pdf, corrective-actions-timeline.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <sandeep@fastretail.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final RCA & corrective-action slate + exec readout invite (Fri 11:00 PT)

Thanks everyone — quick clarifications from infra side:

- The log bundle shows repeated cache-key mismatches tied to sequence IDs 7xx–9xx; I will add a dedicated anomaly alert that fires at 5 mismatches/min and create a lightweight dashboard for you to watch during the post-deploy window.
- I’ll attach the alert config to SRV-2389 and post the policy as a gist; provisional ETA remains 2028-09-06.

Action: I’ll run a manual smoke test after Markus’s SDK patch lands and will confirm pass/fail to Grace for customer validation.

-Kim

I’ll report pass/fail in the readout and aim to push to stable next week if green.

-Markus
